description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

Two functions in `pkix-path/src/lib.rs` exceed `clippy::pedantic`'s
`too_many_lines` threshold (100 lines):

- `fn chain_walk(...)` at line 1996: **489 lines**
- `fn check_name_constraints(...)` at line 2843: **109 lines**

Both implement RFC 5280 §6.1 phases. `chain_walk` is the §6.1 state-machine
driver and is the most security-critical function in the workspace. Function
length alone is not a correctness issue, but at 489 lines it has 14+ distinct
inline phases (signature alg allowlist, signature verify, validity, validity
window, key size, key usage, BasicConstraints, name constraints, policy tree,
explicit-policy counter, etc.). Each phase is independently testable, but
because they share the loop's mutable `working_*` state, they are currently
inseparable.

This is a maintainability finding, not a correctness one. The phases that are
trivially extractable (each is a self-contained block with `?`-propagated
errors and small captured state) should be lifted into helper functions on the
chain-walk loop body. Specifically:

- (a0) `check_signature_alg(cert, policy, index)`
- (a) `verify_signature(cert, working_spki, verifier, index)`
- (b)/(c) `check_subject_name(cert, working_issuer_name, ...)`
- (d) policy-tree update
- (e) `check_validity_window(cert, policy, index)`
- (f) `check_key_size(cert, policy, index)`
- (h) `check_basic_constraints(cert, ...)`

Each helper would be 15-40 lines. The driver loop becomes ~80 lines and is
readable end-to-end without scrolling.

`check_name_constraints` (109 lines) has one nested closure. Splitting that
closure into a free function would drop it under threshold.

Fix: refactor under PR-only review; keep the per-phase semantics identical
(no behavior change), allow the existing PKITS test corpus to validate.

Note: the `too_many_lines` lint is in `clippy::pedantic` (default-allow), so
this is not blocking; it is filed as a P3 idiom finding because the structure
is the single biggest barrier to onboarding new maintainers in this workspace.

title: (IDIOM) P3: chain_walk (489 lines) and check_name_constraints (109 lines) exceed clippy too_many_lines threshold
